reason: The bill amount input, shown with the error Must be a dollar value., has no label element, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so its name is the 0.00 placeholder and the only text beside it is a $ prefix. Screen-reader users hear 0.00 instead of what the field is, which fails 3.3.2 and 4.1.2; the $ prefix and the error exposed through aria-errormessage keep the task possible, so it stays medium.

value.template: textbox "<amount>" [invalid=true, errormessage=Must be a dollar value.]
